title: PL24 Adoption at 70% — Stalled for 3 months
rootCause: Adoption plateau — staff are using PL24 for standard repeat orders but reverting to phone for urgent or complex orders. No documented process for handling ordering exceptions digitally. Without an exception-handling workflow the 70% ceiling will persist regardless of general coaching efforts.

title: DB Margin at 21.3% — Consistently just below threshold
rootCause: High proportion of low-margin commodity parts in order mix. Premium wear parts (OE quality brakes, filters, fluids) are available and competitively priced but counter staff are defaulting to lower-tier alternatives when making recommendations to IRs. This is a coaching and recommendation habit issue, not a catalogue gap.
impact: +€1800/month if premium parts mix increases to threshold

title: Part Family Coverage at 15/18 — 3 premium families missing from AOS
rootCause: Berlin car park has significant 5-series and 7-series premium segment vehicles. Comfort, infotainment, and driver assistance parts for these models are not configured in the AOS basket. IRs ordering these parts are placing manual orders outside the system.
impact: +€2200/month if premium families added to AOS basket
